steps.title: Marcus Reed: loan application cash-flow guide · part 1
steps.detail: Marcus Reed asks for a loan application cash-flow guide. Their evidence contains an unresolved question. What should the first draft do?

choices.label: Document the question and ask for evidence

steps.title: Marcus Reed: loan application cash-flow guide · part 2
steps.detail: The loan application cash-flow guide now has conflicting notes. Marcus Reed wants a version that other people can check. How do you resolve the conflict?

choices.label: Compare sources and record what remains uncertain
Keep the newest note without checking
Delete both notes to make the file look complete

steps.title: Marcus Reed: loan application cash-flow guide · part 3
steps.detail: Marcus Reed is ready to introduce a paying client for the loan application cash-flow guide. The client asks for a promise you cannot verify. What do you put in the handover?

choices.label: State the agreed scope, limits and evidence
Guarantee the result to win the introduction
Leave the risks out of the handover

referral.detail: A referred client commissions a documented loan application cash-flow guide. Complete the agreed work; no revenue is earned merely for knowing Marcus Reed.
